shots.scene: extreme wide shot of a steep mountain trail before dawn, deep blue hour sky, a small lake far below in the valley, a tiny lone figure hiking up the trail far away

shots.scene: low angle view from behind, in the sharp foreground green leaves and mountain grass covered with many clear cold dew drops and light frost, he climbs a steep rocky mountain path ahead slightly out of focus, thick mist in the valley, cold blue dawn light, shallow depth of field

shots.scene: wide landscape, a vast sea of clouds below dark mountain peaks, the horizon beginning to glow pink and gold before sunrise, no people
shots.motion: the sea of clouds flows slowly between the peaks, the horizon glow grows gradually warmer, very slow camera pan, stylized 3D animated movie, calm epic motion

shots.scene: full body, front view, he steps up onto the rocky mountain summit with a happy smile, early morning light, sky turning gold

shots.scene: view from behind, full body, he stands on the mountain summit facing the rising sun above a sea of clouds, golden sunrise light, backpack visible
shots.motion: he stands still facing the sunrise, the sun slowly rises above the clouds, warm light spreads across the sky, gentle wind, slow camera drift sideways, stylized 3D animated movie, calm epic motion

shots.scene: medium shot, three-quarter view, warm golden sunrise light on his face, peaceful smile, sea of clouds blurred behind
